title: lolium rigidum var. tenue
intro: Lolium rigidum var. tenue, commonly known as slender ryegrass, is a type of grass species in the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, skin irritations, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of slender ryegrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of slender ryegrass as a medicinal plant.
